cta.title: Ready to Join the Fun?
cta.desc: Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, the Hanoi Lucky Chess Club welcomes you. Come for the games, stay for the community!

whoCanJoin.title: What to Expect?
whoCanJoin.p1: We welcome players of all ages and skill levels, from complete beginners to experienced players who enjoy sharp games and serious competition. Children are also warmly welcome to learn and play in our friendly international chess community.
whoCanJoin.p2: We do more than play chess. We discuss chess fundamentals, theory, strategies, and tactics while learning and improving together. Many members also practice their English through chess, make new friends, and connect with people from different cultures and countries.
whoCanJoin.p3: We often gather for meals before or after our over-the-board (OTB) games. There are no membership or participation fees, and we have enough chess sets and clocks for everyone to play.
whoCanJoin.p4: We are committed to holding our meetings according to the announced schedule, regardless of weather or other challenges. The only regular exception is the Tết holiday, when any days without meetings are announced in advance through our Zalo and Facebook groups and Facebook page.

imageCarousel.caption: That’s us every Friday & Sunday here in Hanoi

items.q1: How often does the club meet?
items.a1: We meet twice a week: every Friday evening from 19:00 to 23:00 and every Sunday afternoon from 14:00 to 18:00.
items.a2: We play at Horizon Coffee in Phung Khoang, Ha Dong, Hanoi, a cozy, friendly venue with plenty of space, good lighting, and great drinks.
items.a5: There are no dues or fees at all for participation and membership. Chess should be accessible. You pay only for your own drinks or snacks at the cafe.
items.q8: Can I bring my own chess set or clock?
items.a8: We have enough boards and clocks for everyone to play and you are welcome to bring your own as well.
items.q9: Do I need to register before coming?
items.a9: No registration is needed. Just come, say "Hello", take a seat, and enjoy some chess!
items.q10: Do you play casual or competitive chess?
items.a10: Both! Some players enjoy relaxed friendly games, laughing, joking and talking smack, while others challenge each other in more serious matches and blitz sessions.
items.q11: Can kids or younger players join?
items.a11: Younger players are welcome as we believe chess is a great way for kids to develop critical thinking and social skills.
items.q12: Do girls and women play chess with you?
items.a12: Among our best chess players are girls and women. We often offer a prize for the best female player at our chess tournaments.
items.q14: How can I get more information about the chess club and its meetings?
items.a14: You can call Francis Lloyd Holland by Zalo and WhatsApp at 333 009 587 or email us at francislholland@gmail.com
